primary_signal.definition: At128accounts in each cohort, history regresses in at least two distinct streams while current A/C remain correct in both worlds. Descriptive replication gate, not significance.

metrics.interpretation: Initial evidence occurs once in the same distant position and common prefix; both final A values differ from the initial answer. A remaining functional effect does not isolate recurrent-state damage or justify shared-interface necessity. Low hold-world history competence limits absence claims. Related value siblings/roles/worlds are not independent observations.

interpretation: Test whether natural historical-A update regressions persist after removing the original no-op control shortcut that repeated the initial answer near the question. This is a native diagnostic before any new semantic update architecture, not a claim that previous B regressions were invalid.
